excerpts.content:
Two EIP-8141 PRs are open and could use eyes from the authors 🙏 

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12091 writes down block inclusion, which the spec only implies today: a transaction reserves max_gas against the block limit, and inclusion eligibility is a property of payer, so it is only known after the validation prefix has run.

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12061 derives the JSON-RPC receipt status from the frame receipts, and https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12066 bans SLOTNUM during prefix execution.

Also left a review on https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12086, main point is that the new check is capped per transaction but not per block.
